recipe.title: Grape and apple bircher with hazelnuts
recipe.intro: November grapes from Europe are sweet and crisp, just right for waking up a bowl of soaked oats. Ten minutes tonight means breakfast is ready when you are.
steps: The night before, tip the oats, sultanas, cinnamon and salt into a mixing bowl and stir together.
Squeeze in the orange juice, pour in the water and stir well so every oat is wet. Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, or for at least 8 hours.
In the morning, the oats will be soft, thick and creamy. Grate the apples straight into the bowl, skin and all, avoiding the core, and stir through.
If it feels too stiff, loosen with a splash of water until it drops easily off a spoon.
Spoon into four bowls, then top with the halved grapes and chopped hazelnuts.
recipe.tip: The soaked oats keep in the fridge for 3 days, so make a double batch and add the apple, grapes and nuts fresh each morning.
